# Standard Hero

`hero/standard` &middot; section-level &middot; category: hero

## Purpose

Eyebrow, headline, description and button, with an image below or above the text.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `description` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered text with the image below.
- **image-first**: The image above the text. Sets `imagePosition: above`.
- **left**: Left-aligned text, image below. Sets `align: left`.
- **dark**: White text on the primary brand color. Sets `background: @colors.primary`, `buttonBackground: @colors.primaryText`, `buttonColor: @colors.primary`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `eyebrowColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `headingLevel` | one of `h1`, `display`, `h2` | `"h1"` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `below`, `above` | `"below"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables and text, all honored. Rounded image corners ignored. | Fine. The image is a real img, never a background. | Swaps on the brand surface or background. Keeps its colors on a colored background. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('hero/standard', {
  "eyebrow": "New for summer",
  "headline": "Summer Collection",
  "description": "Made for slower mornings and warmer days. Breathable linens and washed cottons, ready when you are.",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Shop the collection",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
  },
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/600x340/png?text=Summer",
    "alt": "A linen shirt, canvas tote and sun hat laid out on a sunny bench"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "hero/standard",
  "data": {
    "eyebrow": "New for summer",
    "headline": "Summer Collection",
    "description": "Made for slower mornings and warmer days. Breathable linens and washed cottons, ready when you are.",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Shop the collection",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
    },
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/600x340/png?text=Summer",
      "alt": "A linen shirt, canvas tote and sun hat laid out on a sunny bench"
    }
  }
}
```
